rows.grounds: compound denoting purpose; dative of avāpti (attainment) governed by preceding members āyuḥ, lakṣmī, vala, ārogya

items.question: What specific attainments justify the undertaking of a ritual resolve?
premises: Ritual action may be directed toward desired attainments.
Life, fortune, strength, and health are such desired attainments.
A ritual resolve serves as the means to pursue these attainments.
items.inference: Therefore one should perform a resolve aimed at obtaining life, fortune, strength, and health.
uncertainties: The internal structure of the compound āyuḥ+lakṣmī+vala+ārogya+avāptyai is taken as a determinative compound with avāpti as the head.
items.plain_english: One should make a resolve for the attainment of life, fortune, strength, and health.
